svg.title: Spirit of the Primal Fire: The Judgment · Shin · Spirit and Fire (Book T deck, linocut)
svg.desc: A linocut printing of the full imagery. Book T gives the Keys their meanings only, no picture. Drawn from the Key's title and the figure the tradition gives it, as a symbol (no faces): an angel in the clouds sounding the trumpet, and figures rising from the tomb; Spirit and Fire. Book T (1912): "Final decision, judgment, sentence, determination of a matter without appeal, "on its plane."" Parts drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); printed by scripts/build_book_t_linocut.py.

g.text: The Judgment · Shin · Spirit and Fire
